# Lourival Rodrigues de Lima {.unnumbered}

::: {.academic-role}
Mathematician · Professor at ESPOL
:::

::: {.lead}
I study the interaction between random processes, dynamical systems, and geometric structures.
:::

::: {.research-keywords}
Stochastic analysis · Rough paths · Stochastic flows · SPDEs
:::

## Current projects

::: {.project-grid}
::: {.home-project}
### Rough paths and Navier–Stokes
Fluid equations under irregular perturbations and projected transport.

[Explore the project →](research.qmd)
:::

::: {.home-project}
### Goldbach and Alexandroff spaces
Relational topology and topological characterizations associated with Goldbach representations.

[Explore the project →](research.qmd)
:::

::: {.home-project}
### Spatial inference through SPDEs
Likelihood-based inference for spatial regression with censored and missing responses.

[Explore the project →](research.qmd)
:::
:::

## About me

I teach mathematics at ESPOL's Faculty of Natural Sciences and Mathematics. I obtained my master's degree and doctorate in Mathematics at Universidade Estadual de Campinas (UNICAMP), following undergraduate studies at Universidade Federal do Pará.

[Academic CV →](cv.qmd)

::: {.section-grid}
::: {}

Random processes, dynamics, and geometric structures. [Explore my research interests](research.qmd).
